description: Defines the 'Interview' entity class for the OrangeHRM Recruitment Plugin, encapsulating interview details, associations with candidates, vacancy, and interviewers, along with ORM mappings.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Represents a job interview, including associated candidate, vacancy, date/time, note, and interviewers, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of the interview.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the interview.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate vacancy linked to this interview.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Associates a candidate vacancy with this interview.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate scheduled for this interview.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a candidate with this interview.

methods.name: getInterviewName
methods.description: Retrieves the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled time of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewTime
methods.description: Sets the scheduled time of the interview.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to the interview.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Adds or updates notes for the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of interviewers assigned to this interview.
